2) Marketplace preference: do you prefer buying through your marketplace (faster approval) or direct vendor relationship?

Hi Karthik — thanks for the follow-up and the materials. Quick answers from our side: 

- Our standard path is PO (Net30). Finance rarely approves one-off card payments for vendor platforms unless the spend is very small and we have a business justification.
- Marketplace purchases are preferred by procurement because they auto-attach vendor profile and reduce onboarding time, but they are not strictly required.
- For vendor onboarding we generally need: W9 (or equivalent), completed vendor questionnaire (we’ll send a link), SOC2 report if you have one, and bank details for ACH.

I’m copying Tom from AP. Tom — can you confirm if AcmeCloud can accept Redwood under our standard PO terms and whether we have any additional commercial constraints? Also flag any portal steps the vendor needs to complete.

Karthik — we’re interested in a pilot, but AP will need the vendor pack before we can issue a PO. Happy to schedule a short procurement call to walk through the checklist.

Best,
Lila
Head of Platform Partnerships
AcmeCloud

Hi Karthik / Lila — Tom here on behalf of AP. A few clarifications on the onboarding and payment options: 

1) Required artifacts to create a vendor record and issue a PO: W9 (US vendors), signed vendor questionnaire (link below), SOC2 Type II or equivalent security attestation, and ACH banking details.
2) Marketplace: If Redwood is listed in our marketplace the procurement lead time drops significantly because our system syncs vendor metadata and tax docs. If not listed, manual vendor setup can add ~10 business days.
3) Card payments: possible for initial pilots under $10k but require a justification memo and finance sign-off; they will add a 2.5% processing fee.
4) Pricing approvals: standard review — send the detailed pricing spreadsheet and an SOW showing pilot scope and deliverables.

Vendor questionnaire (submit here): https://vendors.acmecloud.com/onboard/0923

If you can submit the pack (W9, SOC2 link, banking template) we’ll start the intake. Happy to join a 30-min procurement call to walk the steps.

Thanks,
Tom Wells
Accounts Payable Manager
AcmeCloud
